default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.verdict: The correct answer is 1. 仁義 (じんぎ—humanity and justice; moral principles).
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.explanation:
・Vocabulary: 仁義（じんぎ）: benevolence, moral principles; in Japanese culture, also refers to rules and codes of honor, especially in underworld/yakuza circles. The idiom 「仁義なき戦い」 (a war without honor / a ruthless war fought by any means) is very well known.
・Kanji and character analysis:
  + 仁: compassion, benevolence, morality. It consists of the person radical 亻 and the number two 二. On-readings: ジン, ニ (e.g., 仁愛 - じんあい - benevolence; 仁徳 - じんとく - virtue).
  + 佳: beautiful, excellent. It consists of the person radical 亻 and 圭. On-reading: カ (e.g., 佳作 - かさく - excellent work; 佳人 - かじん - beautiful person).
  + 義: justice, principles, morality. It consists of 羊 and 我. On-reading: ギ (e.g., 正義 - せいぎ - justice; 義務 - ぎむ - duty).
  + 魏: the state of Wei during the Three Kingdoms period; the surname Wei. It consists of 委 and 鬼. On-reading: ギ (e.g., 魏志倭人伝 - ぎしわじんでん - Gishi Wajinden).
・Extended example: 彼はどんな苦境に立たされても、仲間への仁義を貫く人物だ。(No matter what adversity he faces, he is someone who remains true to his code of honor toward his companions.)
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.why.0: (a) 仁義: the correct kanji. 「仁」, as in benevolence and compassion, has the on-reading ジン, while 「義」, as in justice and righteousness, has the on-reading ギ.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.why.1: (b) 佳義: Incorrect. The kanji 「佳」 is incorrect. In 佳作 かさく and 佳人 かじん, it is read カ, not じん.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.why.2: (c) 仁魏: The kanji 「魏」 is incorrect (the Wei of the Three Kingdoms period, or the surname Wei); it does not mean morality or righteousness.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-5.why.3: (d) 佳魏: Both 「佳」 and 「魏」 are incorrect.

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-6.why.1: (b) 蚊: mosquito; its kun-reading is か, and its on-reading is ブン.

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-7.verdict: The correct answer is 3. 貝塚 (かいづか— a shell mound, a prehistoric pile of shell remains).
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-7.explanation:
・Vocabulary: 貝塚（かいづか）: shell mound, shell midden (an archaeological site from prehistoric times, especially the Jomon period in Japan, where ancient people discarded shells, animal bones, and household waste after eating).
・Sino-Japanese readings & kanji analysis:
  + 貝 (BỐI): shellfish, shells, ancient shell money. Kun-reading: かい, On-reading: バイ (examples: 貝殻 - かいがら - shell; 貝類 - かいるい - bivalve mollusks).
  + 塚 (TRŨNG): raised mound of earth, pile of earth, burial mound. 土 radical + 冢. Kun-reading: つか (changes to the voiced form づか in compounds), example: 一里塚 - いちりづか - old mile marker.
  + 坑 (KHANH): mine shaft, underground pit. On-reading: コウ (examples: 炭坑 - たんこう - coal mine; 坑道 - こうどう - mine tunnel).
・Extended example: 日本各地に残る貝塚の発掘調査により、縄文人の食生活が明らかになった。(Excavation surveys of shell mounds remaining throughout Japan have revealed the dietary habits of the Jomon people.)

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-7.why.1: (b) 海坑: Both kanji are incorrect. 「坑」, as in 炭坑 and 坑道, has the on-reading コウ, not づか.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-7.why.2: (c) 貝塚 (BAIZUKA): the correct kanji. 「貝」 (shellfish, on-reading: かい) combines with 「塚」 (mound, kun-reading: つか → voiced to づか).
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-7.why.3: (d) 貝坑: Incorrect because the kanji 「坑」 is wrong; it means a pit or mine shaft.

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-8.explanation:
・Vocabulary: 追悼（ついとう）: mourning and commemorating the deceased. Common compounds: 追悼式（ついとうしき: memorial service）, 追悼の辞（ついとうのじ: memorial address/eulogy）.

  + 追: to pursue, add, or recall. On-reading: ツイ; kun-reading: お・う (examples: 追加 - ついか - addition; 追究 - ついきゅう - investigation; 追う - おう - to chase).
  + 悼: to grieve or mourn the deceased. It consists of the standing heart radical 忄 and 卓. On-reading: トウ; kun-reading: いた・む (examples: 追悼 - ついとう - mourning; 悼む - いたむ - to grieve and mourn).
  + 恒: lasting, eternal, or constant. It consists of the standing heart radical 忄 and 亘. On-reading: コウ (examples: 恒久 - こうきゅう - permanence; 恒例 - こうれい - annual custom).
・Extended example: 震災で亡くなった多くの犠牲者を追悼するため、毎年追悼式が催される。(A memorial service is held every year to commemorate the many victims who died in the earthquake.)
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-8.why.0: (a) 追恒: The kanji is incorrect. 「恒」(CONSTANT), as in 恒久 こうきゅう (eternal) and 恒例 こうれい (customary), has the reading コウ, not とう.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-8.why.1: (b) 追悼: The kanji are correct. 「追」 combines with 「悼」 to form 「追悼」 (ついとう), meaning mourning or commemorating the deceased.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-8.why.2: (c) 対恒: both kanji are incorrect: 「対」 and 「恒」.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-8.why.3: (d) 対悼: Incorrect kanji. 「対」, used in words such as dialogue and correspondence, does not combine with 悼 in the context of mourning someone who has died.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.verdict: The correct answer is 3. 逐一 (ちくいち — one by one, in detail, without leaving anything out).
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.explanation:
・Vocabulary: 逐一（ちくいち）: in detail, one by one without omitting anything (often used as an adverb with 報告する—to report thoroughly, 説明する—to explain in detail, and 記録する—to record meticulously).
・On'yomi and distinctions among easily confused kanji containing the 辶 radical at the N1 level:
  + 逐 (drive away; one after another): 辶 radical + 豕 (pig). On-reading: チク (examples: 逐一—ちくいち—every detail; 逐次—ちくじ—successively, one after another; 駆逐—くちく—expel, eliminate).
  + 逝 (pass away, pass by): 辶 radical + 折. On-reading: セイ; kun-reading: ゆ・く (examples: 急逝—きゅうせい—pass away suddenly; 逝去—せいきょ—pass away).
  + 遵 (follow, comply with): 辶 radical + 尊. On-reading: ジュン (examples: 遵守 / 遵法—じゅんしゅ / じゅんぽう—observe the law).
  + 迭 (replace, rotate): 辶 radical + 失. On-reading: テツ (example: 更迭—こうてつ—replace or dismiss a senior official).
・Extended example: 現場の進捗状況を逐一上司に報告するように指示された。(I was instructed to report every detail of the progress at the site to my supervisor.)
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.why.0: (a) 逝一: The kanji 「逝」 is incorrect (THỆ, as in 逝去 せいきょ and 急逝 きゅうせい), and its reading is セイ.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.why.1: (b) 遵一: incorrect use of 「遵」 (the jun in 遵守 じゅんしゅ, “to comply with”); its reading is ジュン.
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.why.2: (c) 逐一 is the correct kanji. 「逐」 means “to pursue” or “one by one” (on-reading: チク), and combined with 「一」 (いち), it forms 「逐一」 (ちくいち), meaning “in detail, one by one.”
default.q.n1-u10-mon2-9.why.3: (d) 迭一: Incorrect. The character 「迭」 is the one used in 更迭 (こうてつ, personnel changes), and its reading is テツ.

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-10.explanation:
・Vocabulary: 窯（かま）: kiln (for pottery, porcelain, glass, tiles, lime, etc.). Distinguish it from 釜（かま — a cast-iron pot or rice-cooking pot）.
・On'yomi and distinctions among advanced kanji containing the 穴, 宀, and 艹 radicals:
  + 窯 (kiln): 穴 radical + 羔 (or 羊 + 火). Kun-reading: かま. On-reading: ヨウ (e.g., 窯元 - かまもと - pottery kiln workshop; 登り窯 - のぼりがま - climbing kiln).

default.q.n1-u10-mon2-10.why.0: (a) 宵: evening, nighttime; kun-reading よい, on-reading ショウ (for example, 宵の口, early evening).

- **Meaning**: 未曾有 (みぞう) is an idiom meaning “unprecedented, never before seen in history.” It originated in Buddhism and was translated from the Sanskrit word Adbhuta.
- **Kanji and readings**:
  + **未曾有** has the special conventional reading **みぞう** (the sound of 有 is omitted rather than pronounced as ゆう/う).
  + **未**: on-reading ミ (未定 - みてい: undecided; 未知 - みち: unknown; 未満 - みまん: less than, below).
  + **曾**: on-readings ソウ / ゾウ (曾祖母 - そうそぼ: great-grandmother), kun-reading かつ・て (formerly, once).

• 挑戦: challenge, take on a challenge, challenge oneself.
• 挑: on-reading チョウ (as in 挑戦 ちょうせん: challenge and 挑発 ちょうはつ: provocation); kun-reading いど・む (挑む: to challenge, confront).
• 戦: on-reading セン (as in 戦争 せんそう: war and 作戦 さくせん: strategy, operation); kun-readings たたか・う (戦う: to fight) and いくさ (war, battle).
• Example: 失敗を恐れずに新しい分野に挑戦する (To challenge oneself in a new field without fearing failure).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-1.why.0: (a) Incorrect. たいせん is the reading of 対戦 (a head-to-head match). 挑 does not have the reading たい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-1.why.1: (b) Incorrect. りんせん can be the reading of 臨戦. 挑 is not read as りん.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-1.why.2: (c) Incorrect. こうせん is not the correct reading of 挑 in 挑戦.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-1.why.3: (d) Correct. 挑戦 consists of 挑 (on-reading チョウ) and 戦 (on-reading セン), giving ちょうせん and meaning “challenge” or “to challenge.”
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: してき.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.explanation:
• 指摘: to point out, identify, or call attention to an error, shortcoming, or problem.
• 指: on-reading シ (e.g., 指示 しじ: instruction; 指定 してい: designation; 指導 しどう: guidance), kun-readings ゆび (finger), さ・す (to point at).
• 摘: on-reading テキ (e.g., 指摘 してき: pointing out; 摘出 てきしゅつ: extraction; 摘発 てきはつ: exposing), kun-reading つ・む (to pick, pluck).
• Example: 専門家に論文の不備を指摘された (An expert pointed out flaws in my paper).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.why.0: (a) Correct. 指摘 consists of 指, with the on-reading シ, and 摘, with the on-reading テキ. Together they are read してき and mean “to point out” or “to identify” an error or problem.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.why.1: (b) Incorrect. しなん is the reading of 指南 (guidance or instruction) or 至難 (extremely difficult). 摘 is not read なん.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.why.2: (c) Incorrect. しどう is the reading of 指導 (guidance, instruction). 摘 is not read as どう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-2.why.3: (d) Incorrect. しっぱい is the reading of 失敗 (failure); 摘 is not read as っぱい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: けんじつ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.explanation:
• 堅実 (けんじつ): steady, sound, practical, reliable, especially in one’s lifestyle, plans, or business.
• 堅 (けん / かた・い): On-reading ケン, as in 堅実 (けんじつ: steady), 堅固 (けんご: firm, solid), and 堅持 (けんじ: steadfastly maintain); kun-reading かた・い (hard, firm, resolute).
• 実 (じつ / み / みの・る): On-reading ジツ, as in 事実 (じじつ: fact) and 確実 (かくじつ: certain, reliable); kun-readings み (fruit) and みの・る (to bear fruit).
• Example: 彼は堅実な仕事ぶりで周囲から信頼されている (He is trusted by those around him for his steady and careful work.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.why.0: (a) Correct. 堅実 consists of 堅 (on-reading ケン) and 実 (on-reading ジツ), combining to form けんじつ, meaning steady, reliable, and practical.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.why.1: (b) Incorrect. てきとう is the reading of 適当 (appropriate, careless). 堅 is not read as てき.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.why.2: (c) Incorrect. えんみ is the reading of 塩味 (salty taste). 堅実 is not read as えんみ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-3.why.3: (d) Incorrect. せいじつ is the reading of 誠実 (sincere, honest). 堅 is not read as せい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2: そうにゅう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.explanation:
• 挿入 (そうにゅう): to insert, put in, or embed (such as inserting a card into a slot or an image into a document).
• 挿: on-reading ソウ (as in 挿入 そうにゅう: insertion and 挿話 そうわ: inserted story, episode); kun-readings さ・す, はさ・む (to insert, tuck in).
• 入: on-reading ニュウ (as in 入場 にゅうじょう and 輸入 ゆにゅう); kun-readings はい・る (to enter), い・れる (to put in).
• Distinguishing words containing 入: 挿入 (そうにゅう: insert a physical object), 導入 (どうにゅう: introduce or implement technology), 投入 (とうにゅう: invest or put into).
• Example: 文書の中に図を挿入する (Insert a diagram into the document.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.why.0: (a) Incorrect. どうにゅう is the reading of 導入 (“introducing” or “adopting” something). 挿 is not read どう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.why.1: (b) Correct. 挿入 consists of 挿 (on-reading ソウ) and 入 (on-reading ニュウ), combining to form そうにゅう, meaning to insert, put in, or stuff in.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.why.2: (c) Incorrect. とうにゅう is the reading of 投入 (putting in, throwing in, investing capital). 挿 is not read as とう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-4.why.3: (d) Incorrect. こうにゅう is the reading of 購入 (purchasing). 挿 is not read as こう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: ぼうはてい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.explanation:
• 防波堤 (ぼうはてい): breakwater; figuratively, a protective shield or safety barrier.
• 防: on-reading ボウ (as in 防止 ぼうし - prevention, 消防 しょうぼう - firefighting, 予防 よぼう - prevention), kun-reading ふせ・ぐ (to prevent, block).
• 波: on-reading ハ (as in 電波 でんぱ - electromagnetic wave, 波及 はきゅう - spreading influence), kun-reading なみ (wave).
• 堤: on-reading テイ (as in 防波堤 ぼうはてい, 堤防 ていぼう - embankment), kun-reading つつみ (embankment). Be careful not to confuse 堤 (テイ - embankment) with 塀 (ヘイ - fence or wall).
• Example: 巨大な高潮を防波堤が食い止めた (The breakwater prevented the huge storm surge from advancing).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.why.0: (a) Incorrect. This choice reads 波 by its kun-reading なみ and misreads 堤 as へい, confusing it with 塀 へい, meaning a fence or wall.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.why.1: (b) Incorrect. This choice reads 波 with its kun-reading (なみ) instead of its on-reading (は).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.why.2: (c) Incorrect. This choice incorrectly reads 堤 as へい, confusing it with the reading of 塀.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-5.why.3: (d) Correct. 防 (on-reading: ぼう) + 波 (on-reading: は) + 堤 (on-reading: てい) forms ぼうはてい, meaning “breakwater.”
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2: はいしゅつ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.explanation:
• 排出: discharge, emission, excretion (of exhaust gas, waste, garbage, etc.).
• 排: on-reading ハイ (as in 排出 はいしゅつ: discharge, 排除 はいじょ: elimination, 排気 はいき: exhaust gas).
• 出: on-readings シュツ / スイ (as in 出発 しゅっぱつ and 出席 しゅっせき), kun-readings で・る (go out) and だ・す (put out, take out).
• Note: Do not confuse it with the homophone 輩出 (はいしゅつ: produce many talented people in succession; e.g., 優秀な人材を輩出する).
• Example: 工場からの有害物質の排出を規制する (Regulate the emission of harmful substances from factories).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.why.0: (a) Incorrect. じょしゅつ results from confusing 排 with 除 (じょ in 除去/除外).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.why.1: (b) Correct. 排出 consists of 排 (on-reading ハイ) and 出 (on-reading シュツ), forming はいしゅつ, meaning “emission, discharge.”
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.why.2: (c) Incorrect. とうしゅつ is the reading of 突出, meaning “to project outward” or “to stand out.” 排 is not read とう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-6.why.3: (d) Incorrect. えんしゅつ is the reading of 演出, meaning production, staging, or direction. 排 is not read えん.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: けった.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.explanation:
• 蹴る (ける): to kick; to flatly reject or turn down a proposal, request, or job offer. In the ta-form, it becomes 蹴った (けった).
• 蹴: kun-reading け・る (to kick); on-reading シュウ, as in 一蹴 (いっしゅう: to dismiss outright, defeat easily).
• Common expression: 内定を蹴る (turn down a job offer after receiving an informal offer of employment).
• Example: 相手の無理な要求を一蹴した。 (I flatly rejected the other party's unreasonable demand.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.why.0: (a) Incorrect. ぶった is the past form of the verb 打つ / ぶつ (to hit, strike). 蹴 is not read ぶ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.why.1: (b) Incorrect. とった is the past tense of 取る / 採る / 捕る (to take, pick, or catch). 蹴 is not read as と.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.why.2: (c) Incorrect. ふった is the past form of 振る (to wave, shake off, or reject someone's feelings) or 降る (to rain). 蹴 is not read as ふ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-7.why.3: (d) Correct. 蹴った is the past form of the verb 蹴る (ける), using the kun-reading of 蹴 (XÚC), and figuratively means to reject or refuse bluntly.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: しゅうちゃく.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.explanation:
• 執着: attachment, fixation, clinging, excessive attachment (to money, possessions, the past, status, and so on).
• 執: on-readings シュウ / シツ (as in 執念 しゅうねん, an obsessive fixation; 執筆 しっぴつ, writing; 執行 しっこう, execution/enforcement), kun-reading と・る (執る, to take hold of; to exercise authority).
• 着: on-readings チャク / ジャク (as in 到着 とうちゃく, arrival; 密着 みっちゃく, close attachment), kun-readings き・る (to wear), つ・く (to arrive; to stick to).
• Note: This word has two readings: しゅうちゃく (the most common) and しっちゃく (less common, with a Buddhist nuance).
• Example: 過去の成功に執着していては進歩がない (If you remain attached to past success, you will not make progress).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.why.0: (a) Correct. 執着 consists of 執, whose on-reading is シュウ, and 着, whose on-reading is チャク. It is commonly pronounced しゅうちゃく and means attachment, fixation, or clinging.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.why.1: (b) Incorrect. こちゃく is the reading of 固着, meaning firmly attached, or results from confusing 執 with 固 (こ) or 拘 (こう/こ).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.why.2: (c) Incorrect. とうちゃく is the reading of 到着 (arrival). 執 is not read as とう.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-8.why.3: (d) Incorrect. えんちゃく is the reading of 延着, meaning to arrive late or be delayed. 執 is not read えん.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2: たくみに.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.explanation:
• 巧み (たくみ): skillful, ingenious, artful. The adverbial form 「巧みに」 means skillfully, cleverly, or craftily.
• 巧: kun-reading たく・み (skillful), on-reading コウ (as in 巧妙 こうみょう: clever, ingenious; 精巧 せいこう: exquisite, finely made; 技巧 ぎこう: technique, craftsmanship).
• 罠 (ワナ): trap, snare.
• Example: 巧みな話術で客を引き付ける (Attract customers with highly skillful sales talk).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.why.0: (a) Incorrect. ちなみに is written 因みに (by the way, incidentally). 巧 is not read as ちな.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.why.1: (b) Correct. 巧みに is the adverbial form of the na-adjective 巧み (たくみ), using the kun-reading of 巧 and meaning skillfully or deftly.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.why.2: (c) Incorrect. うまみに is associated with 旨味 (delicious or savory taste). 巧 is not read as うまみ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-9.why.3: (d) Incorrect. たらみに is not a meaningful word in this context, and 巧 is not read as たらみ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: がまん.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.explanation:
• 我慢 (NGÃ MẠN): endurance, patience, self-restraint.
• 我 (NGÃ): on-reading ガ (in 我慢 がまん, 自我 じが - ego, 我流 がりゅう - one's own style), kun-readings われ, わ (I, we).
• 慢 (MẠN): on-reading マン (in 傲慢 ごうまん - arrogance, 慢性 まんせい - chronic, 怠慢 たいまん - negligence, carelessness).
• Related expressions: 我慢強い (がまんづよい - persevering, highly tolerant), パワハラ (short for Power Harassment - workplace bullying or harassment through abuse of authority).
• Example: どんなに辛くても最後まで我慢した (No matter how difficult it was, I endured it to the end).
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.why.0: (a) Correct. 我慢 consists of 我 (on-reading ガ) and 慢 (on-reading マン), forming がまん, meaning “endurance, patience, self-restraint.”
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.why.1: (b) Incorrect. じまん is the reading of 自慢, meaning boasting or conceit. 我 is not read じ.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.why.2: (c) Incorrect. がたい is the suffix 難い, meaning “difficult to do,” as in 信じがたい (hard to believe). 我慢 is not read as がたい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon1-10.why.3: (d) Incorrect. じたい is the reading of 事態 (situation) or 自体 (itself). 我慢 is not read as じたい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 撒く (まく).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.explanation:
- **Meaning:** 「撒く」（まく）means to scatter, sow, spray, sprinkle, or spread (water, seeds, fertilizer, pesticides, etc.).
- **Kanji:**
  - **撒** (consisting of the hand radical 扌, indicating an action performed with the hand, and 散, meaning to scatter): Kun-reading: まく (maku), On-readings: サツ (satsu), サン (san). Representative compounds: 撒布（さんぷ - spraying or scattering medicine/water）, 撒水（さっすい/さんすい - watering).
  - **撤** (to remove, withdraw, or dismantle): On-reading: テツ (tetsu). Compounds: 撤去（てっきょ - removal/dismantling）, 撤回（てっかい - withdrawal or retraction of a decision).
  - **揺** (to sway or shake): Kun-readings: ゆれる (yureru - to shake), ゆらす (yurasu - to make something shake). On-reading: ヨウ (yō). Compound: 動揺（どうよう - emotional disturbance).
  - **揃** (to arrange or gather everything together): Kun-readings: そろえる (soroeru - to gather a complete set), そろう (sorou - to be complete).
- **Example:** 暑い夏の夕方、庭に水を**撒いた**。(On a hot summer evening, I sprinkled water around the garden.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.why.0: (a) Incorrect. 揺 (“to shake”) has the kun-readings ゆれる (yureru) and ゆらす (yurasu); there is no form 「揺く」.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.why.1: (b) Incorrect. 「揃」has the kun-readings そろえる (soroeru) and そろう (sorou), but it does not have the form 「揃く」.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 「撤」 (撤回, 撤去) has only the on-reading テツ (tetsu); it has no kun-reading 「撤く」. Although it resembles 撒, the right-hand components differ: 撤 contains 育 + 攵, whereas 撒 contains 散.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-1.why.3: (d) Correct. 「撒」 means “to sow, scatter, or spray” and has the kun-reading まく (maku). 「農薬を撒く」 means “to spray pesticide.”
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: 撫でる (なでる).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 「撫でる」（なでる）means to stroke or caress, such as a child’s head, a pet, or someone’s cheek.
- **Kanji**:
  - **撫**: kun-reading なでる (naderu - to stroke, caress); on-readings ブ and フ. Common compounds include 愛撫（あいぶ - affectionate caressing）and 撫育（ぶいく - raising and nurturing with care）.
  - **触**: kun-readings さわる (to touch) and ふれる (to come into contact with, touch lightly); on-reading ショク. Compounds include 接触（せっしょく - contact）and 感触（かんしょく - tactile sensation）.
- **Example**: 母親は泣いている子供の頭を優しく**撫でて**あげた。(The mother gently stroked her crying child’s head.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.why.0: (a) Correct. The kanji「撫」(to stroke or caress) combines with the okurigana「でる」to form the verb「撫でる」(なでる - naderu).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.why.1: (b) Incorrect. 「触」 is read さわる (sawaru) or ふれる (fureru); it does not combine with the okurigana 「でる」.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.why.2: (c) Incorrect. The correct kanji 「撫」 is used, but the okurigana is incorrect (「で」 is missing; the standard form is 「撫でる」).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-2.why.3: (d) Incorrect. 「触る」is read as さわる (sawaru - to touch), not 「なでる」.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2: 惜しい (おしい).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.explanation:
- Word meaning: 「惜しい」（おしい）means regrettable or unfortunate, especially when you almost achieve a goal, or precious and too good to waste, as with time, money, or talent.
- Kanji:
  - **惜** (TÍCH, consisting of the heart radical 忄 and 昔): Kun-readings: おしい (oshii - regrettable, a shame), おしむ (oshimu - to begrudge, make the most of). On-readings: セキ (seki), シャク (shaku). Common compounds: 惜敗（せきはい - a heartbreaking narrow defeat）, 哀惜（あいせき - sorrow and regret）, 惜別（せきべつ - reluctance to part）.
  - **恨** (HẬN, consisting of the heart radical 忄 and 艮): Kun-readings: うらむ (uramu - to resent, hold a grudge), うらめしい (urameshii - resentful, infuriating). On-reading: コン (kon). Compound: 痛恨（つうこん - deep regret, bitter remorse）.
- Example: あと1点で合格できたのに、本当に**惜しかった**。 (I could have passed with just one more point; it was such a shame.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.why.0: (a) Incorrect. 「恨しい」is read as うらめしい (urameshii—resentful or hateful), not おしい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.why.1: (b) Correct. The kanji 「惜」 combines with the okurigana 「しい」 to form the i-adjective 「惜しい」（おしい - oshii）.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 「恨」cannot form 「恨い」; the correct i-adjective form is 恨めしい.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-3.why.3: (d) Incorrect. The kanji 「惜」 is correct, but the okurigana is wrong (「し」 is missing; the standard form is 「惜しい」).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2: 揃える (そろえる).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.explanation:
- **Meaning of the word:** 「揃える」（そろえる）means to collect enough to complete a set, acquire everything needed, or arrange things neatly and orderly.
- **Kanji:**
  - **揃** (composed of the hand radical 扌 + 前): Kun-readings: そろえる (soroeru — transitive verb: collect enough, arrange evenly), そろう (sorou — intransitive verb: become complete, become uniform). On-reading: セン (sen).
  - **揚** (composed of the hand radical 扌 + 昜): Kun-readings: あげる (ageru — fry, raise a flag), あがる (agaru — rise, increase). On-reading: ヨウ (yō). Representative compounds: 掲揚（けいよう — raising a flag), 意気高揚（いきこうよう — rising enthusiasm).
- **Example:** 面接の前に、必要な書類を全部**揃えて**おいてください。(Please prepare all the necessary documents before the interview.)
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.why.0: (a) Incorrect. 「揚」, meaning “to fry” or “to raise,” is read as あげる (ageru), not そろえる. It resembles 「揃」, but its right-hand component is 昜 rather than 前.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.why.1: (b) Correct. The kanji 「揃」 combines with the okurigana 「える」 to form the transitive verb 「揃える」（そろえる - soroeru）.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 「揚」does not form the word 「揚る」; its intransitive verb form is 揚がる (あがる).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-4.why.3: (d) Incorrect. The kanji 「揃」is correct, but the okurigana is wrong; the standard transitive verb is 「揃える」, with え included.
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-5.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3: 惨め (みじめ).
default.q.n1-u3-mon2-5.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 「惨め」（みじめ - na-adjective）means miserable, wretched, pitiful, humiliated.

default.q.n1-u4-mon3-5.why.3: (d) かんてい: Correct. 鑑 has the on-reading かん and 定 has the on-reading てい, forming 鑑定（かんてい, “appraisal,” “assessment”).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-6.explanation:
- Word meaning: 事項 (SỰ HẠNG) - an item, provision, or matter requiring attention.
- On-readings and readings of the kanji:
  - 事 (SỰ): On-reading: ジ (for example, 事故 じこ - accident; 事件 じけん - incident, case; 無事 ぶじ - safely, without incident); Kun-reading: こと (matter, thing).
  - 項 (HẠNG): On-reading: コウ (for example, 項目 こうもく - item, entry; 条項 じょうこう - clause in a contract or law).
  - Common expressions: 注意事項 (ちゅういじこう - points to note), 連絡事項 (れんらくじこう - matters to communicate), 決定事項 (けっていじこう - decisions, matters that have been decided).
  - Distinguish from: 事柄 (ことがら - a matter or issue in general).
- Example: 契約を結ぶ前に、記載されている重要事項をしっかりと確認してください。 (Before signing the contract, please carefully check the important provisions listed in it.)
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-6.why.0: (a) じこう: Correct. 事 has the on-reading じ and combines with 項, read こう, to form 事項 (じこう - item, provision).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-6.why.1: (b) じじ: Incorrect. 項 is not read as じ; じじ is the reading of 時事 (current affairs) or 事々.
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-6.why.2: (c) ことがら: Incorrect. ことがら is the kun-reading of 事柄 (matter, issue), not 事項.
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-6.why.3: (d) ことい: Incorrect. This choice combines the kun-reading of 事 (こと) with an incorrect reading of 項.
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-7.explanation:
- **Meaning of the word**: 是正 (THỊ CHÍNH) - to correct, adjust, or rectify something wrong or unreasonable so that it returns to a proper or standard state.
- **Sino-Vietnamese readings and pronunciations of the kanji**:
  - 是 (THỊ): means “right” or “what is just.” Its on-reading is ゼ (e.g., 是非 ぜひ - THỊ PHI: by all means / right or wrong; 是認 ぜにん - THỊ NHẬN: approval, acknowledgment as correct; 是非曲直 ぜひきょくちょく - right and wrong, justice and injustice).
  - 正 (CHÍNH): its on-readings are セイ and ショウ (e.g., 正確 せいかく - CHÍNH XÁC: accurate; 修正 しゅうせい - TU CHÍNH: correction; 正当 せいとう: legitimate), and its kun-readings are ただ・しい (correct) and ただ・す (to correct or rectify).
  - Common expressions: 不均衡を是正する (to correct an imbalance), 是正勧告 (ぜせいかんこく - a recommendation to rectify a violation), 是正措置 (ぜせいそち - corrective measures).
- **Example**: 格差社会の拡大を防ぐため、税制の不備を是正する必要がある。(To prevent the widening of social inequality, it is necessary to correct deficiencies in the tax system.)
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-7.why.0: (a) しせい: Incorrect. 是 has the on-reading ぜ, not し. しせい is the reading of 姿勢 (posture) or 市政 (municipal government).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-7.why.1: (b) ぜせい: Correct. 是, with the on-reading ぜ, combines with 正, with the on-reading せい, to form 是正 (ぜせい: correction or rectification).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-7.why.2: (c) こうせい: Incorrect. 是 is not read as こう. こうせい is the reading of 公正 (fairness), 構成 (composition), or 校正 (proofreading).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-7.why.3: (d) こんせい: Incorrect. 是 is not read こん. こんせい is the reading of 混成 (“mixture”) or 混声 (“mixed voices”).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.verdict: The correct answer is 3 (さっかく).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.explanation:
- Meaning: 錯覚 (さっかく): illusion, mistaken perception, misconception; a distortion of perception or psychological interpretation.
- Kanji readings:
  - 錯: On-reading サク, as in 試行錯誤 (しこうさくご): trial and error; 交錯 (こうさく): interweaving, confusion; 錯乱 (さくらん): mental confusion. When 錯 is combined with a kanji beginning with the K-row sound, such as 覚 (かく), サク changes to a geminate sound: さっかく.
  - 覚: On-reading カク, as in 感覚 (かんかく): sensation; 自覚 (じかく): self-awareness; 幻覚 (げんかく): hallucination caused by illness. Kun-readings include おぼ・える (to remember), and さ・める (to wake up, realize).
  - Distinction: 錯覚 means an ordinary optical illusion or misconception, whereas 幻覚 means a medically caused hallucination or delusion.
- Example: 目の前の景色があまりにも美しく、まるで夢の中にいるような錯覚にとらわれた。(The scenery before my eyes was so beautiful that I felt as if I were in a dream.)
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.why.0: (a) えんかく: Incorrect. 錯 does not have the reading えん. えんかく is the reading of 遠隔 (“remote”) or 沿革 (“history of development”).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.why.1: (b) とうかく: Incorrect. 錯 is not read とう. とうかく is the reading of 頭角 in the idiom 頭角を現す (to display outstanding talent).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.why.2: (c) さっかく: Correct. 錯 (on-reading: さく) combines with 覚 (on-reading: かく), with the consonant geminating to form さっかく (illusion, misconception).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-8.why.3: (d) しかく: Incorrect. 錯 is not read as し (しかく is the reading of 視覚, “vision,” or 資格, “qualification/certificate”).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.verdict: The correct answer is 1 (はんちょう).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 班長 (BAN-CHŌ) - group leader, team leader, squad leader (the person in charge of a small group, team, or unit at a school, factory, workshop, or organization).
- **On-yomi and readings of the kanji**:
  - 班 (BAN): Its on-yomi is ハン (for example: 救護班 きゅうごはん - rescue team; 班分け はんわけ - dividing into groups). 班 consists of two 玉/王 characters on either side with 刂 in the middle, suggesting the idea of using a knife to divide jade into portions.
  - 長 (CHŌ): Its on-yomi is チョウ (for example: 社長 しゃちょう - company president; 校長 こうちょう - principal; 議長 ぎちょう - chairperson), and its kun-yomi readings include なが・い (long) and おさ (leader, person in charge).
- **Example**: 修学旅行の間、班長が集合時間の確認や点呼を行うことになっている。(During the school trip, the group leader is responsible for confirming the meeting time and taking attendance.)
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.why.0: (a) はんちょう: Correct. The on-reading はん of 班 combines with the on-reading ちょう of 長 to form 班長 (はんちょう - team leader, group leader).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.why.1: (b) えんちょう: Incorrect. 班 is not read as えん (えんちょう is the reading of 延長, meaning extension/prolongation, or 園長, meaning kindergarten principal).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.why.2: (c) しちょう: Incorrect. 班 is not read し; しちょう is the reading of 市長 (mayor) or 視聴 (watching and listening).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-9.why.3: (d) がんちょう: Incorrect. 班 has the on-reading はん, not がん.
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.verdict: The correct answer is 2 (ゆいいつ).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 唯一 (DUY NHẤT) — only, sole, unique; just one and no other.
- **On-readings and readings of the kanji**:
  - 唯 (DUY): means “only; sole.” Its on-readings are ユイ and イ (for example: 唯物論 ゆいぶつろん - materialism; 唯心論 ゆいしんろん - idealism; 唯我独尊 ゆいがどくそん - supreme self-conceit), and its kun-reading is ただ (only).
  - 一 (NHẤT): its on-readings are イチ and イツ (for example: 統一 とういつ - unification; 一致 いっち - agreement; 均一 きんいつ - uniformity: equal pricing/uniformity), and its kun-reading is ひと・つ (one).
  - Common idioms and expressions: 唯一無二 (ゆいいつむに - one and only; unique), 唯一の希望 (唯一の希望 - the only hope).
  - Note: In addition to the most common reading ゆいいつ, the alternative reading ゆいいち is also accepted.
- **Example**: この絵画は世界に一枚しか現存しない、唯一無二の貴重な作品だ。(This painting is a precious, one-of-a-kind work; only one survives in the world.)
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.why.0: (a) とういつ: Incorrect. 唯 is read ゆい, not とう; とういつ is the reading of 統一 (unification).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.why.1: (b) ゆいいつ: Correct. 唯 (on-reading: ゆい) combines with 一 (on-reading: いつ) to form 唯一 (ゆいいつ — only, unique).
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.why.2: (c) かんいつ: Incorrect. 唯 does not have the on-reading かん.
default.q.n1-u4-mon3-10.why.3: (d) ていいつ: Incorrect. 唯 does not have the on-reading てい.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 憤慨 (indignation, outrage).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.explanation:
「憤慨 (ふんがい)」: to feel extremely angry and indignant about rude or unjust behavior.
- 憤: anger, resentment, or indignation held in one's heart (心 radical 忄). Example: 憤り (いきどおり, indignation), 義憤 (ぎふん, righteous indignation).
- 慨: deep emotion, indignation, or lamentation (心 radical 忄). Examples: 感慨 (かんがい, deep emotion), 慨嘆 (がいたん, lamentation).
- Distinguish easily confused kanji:
  + 概: contains the tree radical 木; general, approximate (概念 - がいねん, concept; 大概 - たいがい, generally, approximately).
  + 噴: contains the mouth radical 口; to erupt or spray (噴火 - ふんか, volcanic eruption; 噴水 - ふんすい, fountain).
- Sentence translation: 「無礼な態度にふんがいする」= To be indignant at a rude attitude.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.why.0: (a) Incorrect because 概, meaning “general” or “concept,” contains the 木 radical, not 慨, meaning “to feel indignant” or “to lament,” which contains the 忄 radical.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.why.1: (b) Incorrect because both kanji use the wrong radical: 噴 (erupt, with the Mouth radical 口) is incorrectly written instead of 憤 (with the Heart radical 忄), and 概 (with the Tree radical 木) is incorrectly written instead of 慨 (with the Heart radical 忄).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.why.2: (c) Incorrect because 噴 (meaning “to spurt out”) contains the 口 radical, whereas the correct character is 憤 (meaning “resentment, anger”), which contains the 忄 radical.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-1.why.3: (d) Correct. 憤慨 (PHẪN KHÁI) consists of two characters with the heart radical (忄), indicating emotion: 憤 (indignation) and 慨 (resentment, deep emotion).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 感銘 (a deep impression that remains in one's heart).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.explanation:
「感銘 (かんめい)」: Being deeply moved, profoundly impressed, leaving a lasting impression (often used in the phrase 感銘を受ける: to be deeply moved / profoundly impressed).
- 感: Feelings, perception (e.g., 感動 - かんどう: being moved, 感激 - かんげき: being deeply touched).
- 銘: To engrave or leave a lasting impression (originally referring to engraving words on bronze vessels, stone monuments, or the mind; contains the 金 radical). Examples: 銘記 (めいき: to remember forever), 銘柄 (めいがら: brand, brand name).
- Easily confused character:
  + 酩 (with the 酉 radical associated with alcohol): intoxicated, dead drunk, as in 酩酊 (めいてい: dead drunk, extremely intoxicated).
- Sentence translation: 「かんめいを受ける」= To be deeply moved / To be profoundly impressed and remember it.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.why.0: (a) Both characters are incorrect: 間 (Gian - interval) is wrong instead of 感 (Kan - feeling), and 酩 (Mei - drunken, with the 酉 radical) is wrong instead of 銘 (Mei - engrave deeply, with the 金 radical).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.why.1: (b) Incorrect because 間 (かん: middle, interval) is mistakenly written instead of 感 (かん: feeling, emotion).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.why.2: (c) Incorrect because 酩 (Minh, as in 酩酊 めいてい “drunkenness,” with the 酉 radical) is mistakenly written instead of 銘 (Minh, “engraved in one's memory,” with the 金 radical).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-2.why.3: (d) Correct. 感銘 combines 感 (to feel deeply) and 銘 (to engrave in one's mind; the 金 radical).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.verdict: The correct answer is answer choice 1: 訂正 (correction of erroneous content).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.explanation:
「訂正 (ていせい)」: correction — revising incorrect letters, numbers, wording, or content to make it accurate.
- 訂: revise a document or correct written text. Example: 改訂 (かいてい, revise and republish a book or document).
- 正: correct, rectify. Examples: 正確 (せいかく, accurate), 修正 (しゅうせい, correction, modification).
- Distinguish the following characters with the 言 radical from similar characters with the hand radical:
  + 託: entrust, consign. Examples: 委託 (いたく, entrustment), 託児所 (たくじしょ, daycare center).
  + 誇: boast, exaggerate. Examples: 誇張 (こちょう, exaggeration), 誇る (ほこる, take pride in).
  + 棋: game piece. Example: 将棋 (しょうぎ, Japanese chess).
- Sentence translation: 「問題文をていせいする」 = correct/revise the question text.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.why.0: (a) Correct. 訂正 (訂正) consists of 訂 (teik—revising wording, formed from the speech radical 言 and 丁) and 正 (sei—making something correct).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.why.1: (b) Incorrect because the kanji is 託, as in 委託（いたく）, with 乇 on the right; it is not 訂.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.why.2: (c) Incorrect because 棋, as in 将棋 (しょうぎ), has the 木 radical and does not mean “to correct an error.”
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-3.why.3: (d) Incorrect because 誇 means “to boast” in 誇張 こちょう and 誇る ほこる; it is unrelated to correction.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.verdict: The correct answer is answer choice 2: 賭ける (to bet or wager money).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.explanation:
「賭ける (かける)」: to bet, wager on a game of chance, or stake money, one's life, or one's career (kanji meaning: 賭).
- 賭 (kanji meaning: 賭): to gamble, bet. It consists of the 貝 radical (wealth, money) combined with 者.
  + On: ト (e.g., 賭博 - とばく: gambling, betting).
  + Kun: か・ける (e.g., 命を賭ける - いのちをかける: to stake one's life, 賭け - かけ: a bet).
- Easily confused kanji:
  + 頬 (kanji meaning: 頬 - 頁 radical): cheek (read ほお/ほほ, e.g., 頬紅 - ほおべに: cheek rouge).
  + 賜 (kanji meaning: 賜 - 貝 radical combined with 易): to bestow, grant (e.g., 賜る - たまわる, 賜杯 - しはい: a cup bestowed by the king).
  + 頻 (kanji meaning: 頻 - 頁 radical): frequency, repeatedly (e.g., 頻繁 - ひんぱん: frequently, 頻度 - ひんど: frequency).
- Sentence translation: 「お金をかける」= to bet money / to stake money.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.why.0: (a) Incorrect because 頬 (Giáp - cheek, read ほお / ほほ) does not have the kun-reading 'かける'.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.why.1: (b) Correct. 賭ける means to gamble or bet money, honor, or one's life.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 賜 means “to grant” or “to bestow” and is read たまわる in 賜る or し in 恩賜（おんし）.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-4.why.3: (d) Incorrect because 頻, meaning frequent as in 頻繁 (ひんぱん) and 頻度 (ひんど), is not read かける.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.verdict: The correct answer is answer choice 3: 進呈 (presenting or respectfully giving a commemorative gift).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.explanation:
「進呈 (しんてい)」: to present, bestow, or give a gift formally (Sino-Japanese reading: shintei).
- 進: to offer, advance (e.g., 進呈 - しんてい: present, 進化 - しんか: evolution, 前進 - ぜんしん: advance).
- 呈: to present, display (e.g., 贈呈 - ぞうてい: award, 露呈 - ろてい: reveal, expose). 呈 has the 口 radical above 王/士.
- Easily confused characters:
  + 只: only; has 口 above 八 and is read ただ (free of charge, ordinary). It does not have the horizontal stroke in the middle that 呈 has.
  + 新: new (on-reading しん, but meaning “new,” e.g., 新年 - しんねん: New Year).
- Sentence translation: 「記念品をしんていする」= To present/give a commemorative gift.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.why.0: (a) Incorrect because 新 (new) is confused with 進 (advance or offer), which shares the on-reading しん.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.why.1: (b) is incorrect because both characters are wrong: 新 should be 進, and 只 (meaning “only,” “free,” read ただ) is missing strokes and should be 呈.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.why.2: (c) Correct. 進呈 consists of 進 and 呈, meaning to present or offer a gift.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-5.why.3: (d) Incorrect because 只 (meaning “only,” composed of 口 and 八) is written incorrectly in the shape of 呈, which has an additional horizontal stroke inside.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.verdict: The correct answer is answer choice 2: 誓う (to swear, to vow, to pledge).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.explanation:
「誓う (ちかう)」: to swear, take an oath, or make a solemn promise with determination to fulfill it.
- 誓: an oath, vow. The character consists of 折 (to break, decisively) above 言 (words).
  + On-reading: セイ (e.g., 宣誓 — せんせい: taking an oath; 誓約 — せいやく: oath, written pledge).
  + Kun-reading: ちか・う (誓う: to swear). Note: the kanji 誓 is read as 'ちか', so the okurigana is only 'う'.
- Easily confused kanji:
  + 諾 (言 radical + 若): consent, agreement (e.g., 承諾 — しょうだく: consent; 許諾 — きょだく: permission; Kun-reading うべなう).
  + Okurigana trap: 誓う (correct) vs 誓かう (incorrect because か is added unnecessarily).
- Sentence translation: 「永遠の愛をちかう」= To vow eternal love.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.why.0: (a) Incorrect because 諾 (agreement, as in 承諾 しょうだく) has the kun-reading うべな・う (うべなう), not ちかう.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.why.1: (b) Correct. 誓う means to swear or pledge; the standard okurigana is う.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.why.2: (c) Both the kanji and okurigana are incorrect: 諾 is not read ちかう, and the spelling 諾かう does not exist.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-6.why.3: (d) Incorrect regarding okurigana: Since 誓 is read as ちか, it only needs the ending う to form 誓う; writing 誓かう unnecessarily repeats か.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 要旨 (the main point; the essential content).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.explanation:
「要旨 (ようし)」: the gist—the main points or core content of a text, speech, or essay (the Sino-Vietnamese reading is YẾU CHỈ).
- 要 (YẾU): essential, the main point, summary (e.g., 重要 - じゅうよう: important, 要約 - ようやく: summary, 要点 - ようてん: key point).
- 旨 (CHỈ): main idea, purpose, principle (e.g., 趣旨 - しゅし: purpose, 本旨 - ほんし: main point). The kanji 旨 consists of 匕 (spoon handle) above 日 (sun/day).
- Easily confused words/kanji:
  + 用紙 (ようし - DỤNG CHỈ): paper, form (uses 用 and 紙).
  + 冒 (MẠO): to risk, recklessness (日 above 目; e.g., 冒険 - ぼうけん: adventure, 冒頭 - ぼうとう: beginning).
- Sentence translation: 「ようしをまとめる」= to summarize the gist / summarize the key points.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.why.0: (a) Incorrect because both kanji are wrong: 用 is incorrectly used instead of 要, and 冒 (risk, as in 冒険 ぼうけん) is incorrectly used instead of 旨.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.why.1: (b) Incorrect because 用 (use, as in 用紙 ようし: paper/form) is homophonous with 要 (essential point; 用旨 is not a meaningful word).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 冒 is a different kanji that may look similar, but it is not 旨. The two characters have different meanings and forms.
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-7.why.3: (d) Correct. 要旨 consists of 要 (essential point, summary) and 旨 (main point, gist).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-8.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: 顧みる (to look back on the past; to recall bygone days).
default.q.n1-u4-mon4-8.explanation:
「顧みる (かえりみる)」: to look back over one’s shoulder; to recall or reflect on the past or things that have happened (Sino-Vietnamese reading: CỐ).
- 顧 (CỐ): to turn back and look, to take notice of, to care for (the 頁 radical combined with 雇).
  + On: コ (e.g., 顧問 - こもん: adviser; 顧客 - こきゃく: regular customer; 回顧 - かいこ: recollection).
  + Kun: かえり・みる (e.g., 過去を顧みる: to look back on the past; 顧みない: to pay no attention to).
- Distinguishing the two homophones かえりみる:

default.q.n1-u5-mon2-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3: 軌道 (きどう).

- **Meaning:** 「軌道」（きどう）originally means a railway track or the orbit of a celestial body. Figuratively, it refers to the normal, stable progress or course of an activity or plan. A very common idiom in N1 and business contexts is 「軌道に乗る」（きどうにのる）, meaning that work or a plan begins to proceed smoothly and steadily.
- **Kanji analysis:**
  + **軌** (車 radical): a wheel track, orbit. On-reading: キ (e.g., 軌道 - きどう: orbit, 常軌 - じょうき: normal rule or convention).
  + **道** (辵 radical): road, path, principle. On-readings: ドウ / トウ; kun-reading: みち (e.g., 道路 - どうろ: road; 報道 - ほうどう: news reporting).
  + Distinguish **軌** (車 radical: a wheel track) from **輝** (光 radical: to shine or glitter, as in 輝く - かがやく / 輝かしい - かがやかしい).
- **Sentence translation:** “At last, the business has gotten on track.”
- **Additional example:** 新規事業がようやく軌道に乗ってきた。 (The new business has finally begun to develop steadily.)

default.q.n1-u5-mon2-4.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 「御馳走」（ごちそう - ON-READING: ごちそう）means a delicious meal, an elaborate feast, or hospitality in the form of treating someone to a meal. Common expressions: 「ごちそうになる」(to be treated to a meal), 「ごちそうする」(to treat someone to a meal), and the phrase said after eating: 「ごちそうさまでした」.

  + **馳** (ON-reading: チ; component 馬 combined with 也): To gallop or rush on horseback. On-reading: チ (for example, 馳走 - ちそう). Do not confuse it with **弛** (component 弓), meaning to loosen or slacken, as in 弛緩 - しかん.

  + **Word origin**: In the past, when an honored guest came to visit, the host had to rush around on horseback in all directions ("馳走") to find fresh ingredients and prepare a meal. Later, the honorific prefix 「御」was added, forming 「御馳走」to refer to an elaborate meal or the hospitality of treating someone to food.
- **Example sentence translation**: “To thank them for helping with the event at the farm, I was treated to an elaborate meal.”

default.q.n1-u5-mon2-7.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 飽きてきた (あきてきた).
default.q.n1-u5-mon2-7.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 「飽きる」（あきる - BÃO）means to become bored, tired of something, or fed up with something, usually because of eating or doing the same thing repeatedly. The form 「飽きてきた」 (te-form + くる) expresses the state of “starting to feel bored or tired of something.”
- **Kanji and okurigana analysis**:
  + **飽** (BÃO—食 radical combined with 包): to be full, satiated, fed up. On-reading: ホウ; kun-readings: あ・きる / あ・かす (e.g., 飽和 - ほうわ: saturation; 飽食 - ほうしょく: excessive abundance of food).
  + Distinguish **飽** (BÃO—食 radical: full or fed up) from **抱** (BÃO—hand radical 扌: to hug, embrace, shoulder, or harbor an aspiration, as in 抱く - だく/いだく and 抱える - かかえる).
  + Okurigana rule: The verb 「飽きる」 belongs to the Ichidan group. The kanji 「飽」 is read only as 「あ」, while 「きる」 is the inflected ending written outside the kanji. Therefore, the te-form must be written 「飽きて」; writing 「飽て」 is incorrect.
- **Question sentence translation**: “Since it is always rice seasoned with soy sauce every day, I’m starting to get tired of it.”
- **Additional example**: どんなに好きなゲームでも、毎日やっていると飽きてくる。(No matter how much you like a game, you will start to get bored with it if you play it every day.)

default.q.n1-u5-mon2-7.why.1: (b) Incorrect because 「抱」 (to embrace) is read 「だく」 or 「いだく」 and does not mean to be fed up with something.
default.q.n1-u5-mon2-7.why.2: (c) Incorrect okurigana. When the verb 「飽きる」 (あきる) is changed to the te-form, the 「き」 must remain outside the kanji: 「飽きて」. Writing 「飽て」 is incorrect.
default.q.n1-u5-mon2-7.why.3: (d) Correct because the kanji 「飽」, meaning “to become tired of” or “to be fed up,” takes the correct okurigana in 「飽きてきた」, meaning “to have begun to tire of something.”

default.q.n1-u6-mon4-7.why.2: (c) Correct. 一致 (いっち) means agreement, unity, or a match.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-7.why.3: (d) Incorrect: 鼓 is the wrong second kanji; combined with 一, it does not have the reading いっち.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.verdict: The correct answer is 4. 模索 (searching for, groping for a solution).
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.explanation:
模索 (もさく): searching, groping, or feeling one's way toward a direction or solution under uncertain or difficult circumstances (often seen in 暗中模索 - あんちゅうもさく: groping in the dark).
- 模: on-readings モ and ボ (e.g., 模型 - もけい: model; 規模 - きぼ: scale; 模倣 - もほう: imitation).
- 索: on-reading サク (meaning searching or a rope; e.g., 検索 - けんさく: search; 探索 - たんさく: exploration or searching; 索引 - さくいん: index).
- Look-alike kanji containing similar lower components:
  + 繁: prosperity (e.g., 繁栄 - はんえい; 繁忙 - はんぼう)
  + 牽: pulling or leading (e.g., 牽引 - けんいん)
  + 紫: purple (むらさき).
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.why.0: (a) Incorrect: 繁, meaning numerous or busy and read ハン in 繁栄 and 繁忙, has the 糸 radical beneath 敏.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.why.1: (b) Incorrect: 牽 (used in 牽引 けんいん) has the cow radical underneath.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.why.2: (c) Incorrect: 紫 (むらさき, シ) means “purple” and has the radical 糸 beneath 此.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-8.why.3: (d) Correct: 模索 (もさく) means searching around for a solution, groping for an answer.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.verdict: The correct answer is 1. 矯正 (orthodontic correction, braces; correction).
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.explanation:
矯正 (きょうせい): correcting or straightening something misaligned, bent, or defective so that it returns to the proper position or standard (used for teeth, bones, bad habits, eyesight, etc.).
- 矯: on-reading キョウ (left: 矢, the arrow radical; right: 喬; examples: 矯正 きょうせい - orthodontic correction/correction, 矯小 きょうしょう - small).
- 正: on-readings セイ, ショウ; kun-readings ただ・しい, ただ・す (examples: 正確 せいかく - accurate, 修正 しゅうせい - correction/revision).
- Distinction: Do not confuse 矯 (矢 radical - straighten) with 僑 (亻 radical - overseas Chinese, as in 華僑 かきょう - overseas Chinese).

default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.why.0: (a) Correct: 矯正 (きょうせい) means to correct, straighten, or bring into proper form.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.why.1: (b) Incorrect. 僑, meaning “to stay abroad” or “overseas resident,” as in 華僑 (かきょう), has the 亻 radical.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.why.2: (c) Incorrect: 生 is the wrong second kanji; 矯正 must use 正.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-9.why.3: (d) Incorrect: both 僑 and 生 are wrong.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-10.verdict: The correct answer is 2. 彫る (carve wood, sculpt wood).

彫る (ほる): to carve, engrave, or sculpt designs or figures in materials such as wood, stone, or metal, or to tattoo a design onto skin.

default.q.n1-u6-mon4-10.why.0: (a) Incorrect: 剃る (SHAVE - そる) means to shave, as in 髭を剃る (to shave one's beard) or to cut one's hair.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-10.why.1: (b) Correct: 彫る (ほる) means to carve or engrave wood or stone.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-10.why.2: (c) Incorrect: 刈る (NGẢI - かる) means to cut, trim, or reap, as in cutting grass 草を刈る.
default.q.n1-u6-mon4-10.why.3: (d) Incorrect: 絞る (GIẢO - しぼる) means to wring or squeeze (a towel, oil, or one's brain).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4 (ちゅうじつ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.explanation:

  + 実: On-reading じつ, as in 実際 (じっさい: reality) and 実現 (じつげん: realization); Kun-readings み and みの・る (実る: ripen, bear fruit).
- Sentence translation: "This film is famous for staying very faithful to the original work."
- Additional example: 彼は上司の指示に忠実に従った。(He faithfully followed his supervisor's instructions.)
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.why.0: (a) 「しゃじつ」is the on-reading of「写実」, meaning “realistic depiction” or “realism,” not the reading of 忠.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.why.1: (b) 「かくじつ」 is the on-reading of 「確実」 (certain, sure), not 忠実.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.why.2: (c) 「にょじつ」 is the on-reading of 「如実」 (exactly as it is in reality), not 忠実.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-1.why.3: (d) 「ちゅうじつ」is the correct on-reading of 「忠実」: 忠 (TRUNG - ちゅう) + 実 (THỰC - じつ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3 (めぐる).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.explanation:
- Meaning: 巡る (TUẦN - めぐる) is a verb meaning to travel around or tour various places, or to center on a matter or topic (as in the N1 grammar pattern ～をめぐって).
- Related kanji and readings:
  + 巡 (TUẦN - go around, patrol): kun-reading めぐ・る; on-reading じゅん, as in 巡回 (じゅんかい - patrol, make a circuit) and 巡礼 (じゅんれい - pilgrimage).
- Sentence translation: I quit my job at the company and began a journey around World Heritage sites.
- Additional example: 遺産相続をめぐって親族の間で争いが起きた。(A dispute arose among the relatives over the inheritance.)
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.why.0: (a) 「たどる」is the kun-reading of 辿 (as in 辿る: to trace, follow a trail or route), not the reading of 巡.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.why.1: (b) 「とおる」 is the kun-reading of 通 (as in 通る: to pass through, go through), not 巡.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.why.2: (c) 「めぐる」 is the correct kun-reading of the verb 「巡る」, meaning to go around or tour.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-2.why.3: (d) 「みる」 is the kun-reading of 見 / 観 / 診 (to look, watch, or examine), not 巡.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1 (たいほ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.explanation:
- Meaning of the word: 逮捕 (たいほ) means to arrest or apprehend a criminal (usually carried out by the authorities or police).
- Related kanji and readings:
  + 逮 (たい - to pursue and apprehend): the on-reading is たい; this kanji appears almost exclusively in 逮捕 at the N1 level.
  + 捕 (ほ / つかまえる / つかまる / とらえる - to catch, be caught, seize): the on-reading is ほ in 捕獲 (ほかく - capture); the kun-readings are つか・まえる (to catch), つか・まる (to be caught), and と・らえる (to seize).
- Translation of the question sentence: "Take swift action toward arresting the criminal."
- Additional example: 警察は重要参考人としてその男を逮捕した。(The police arrested the man as a key person of interest.)
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.why.0: (a) 「たいほ」 is the correct on-reading of 「逮捕」: 逮 (たい) + 捕 (ほ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.why.1: (b) 「かくほ」is the on-reading of 「確保」(secure, ensure, maintain), not of 逮.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.why.2: (c) 「だほ」is the on-reading of「拿捕」, meaning “capture of a foreign vessel for illegal intrusion,” not 逮捕.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-3.why.3: (d) 「ろうほ」is not a valid standard Japanese vocabulary reading; it is a sound-based distractor.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3 (もらう).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.explanation:
- Word meaning: 貰う (THẾ - もらう) is the kanji form of the familiar verb もらう (to receive, obtain, be given). In the N1 exam, this kanji is often included to test recognition of common kanji used in everyday life.
- Related kanji and readings:
  + 貰 (THẾ - receive, borrow): kun-reading もら・う; a common compound is 貰い泣き (もらいなき - crying along when seeing someone else cry).
  + 賄 (HỐI): kun-reading まかな・う (賄う - cover expenses, provide meals); on-reading わい in 賄賂 (わいろ - bribery).
  + 拾 (THẬP): kun-reading ひろ・う (拾う - pick up, gather); on-reading しゅう in 拾得物 (しゅうとくぶつ - found property).
- Translation of the question sentence: "Thanks to my beloved teacher, I was able to receive a scholarship."
- Additional example: 誕生日に友達から素敵なプレゼントを貰った。(On my birthday, I received a wonderful present from a friend.)
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.why.0: (a) 「まかなう」 is the kun-reading of 賄 (in 賄う: to pay for, cover expenses), not 貰.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.why.1: (b) 「ひろう」 is the kun-reading of 拾 (as in 拾う: to pick up), not 貰.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.why.2: (c) 「もらう」is the correct kun-reading of 「貰」in the verb 「貰う」(receive or be given).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-4.why.3: (d) 「うけたまわう」is an incorrectly spelled or distractor form of the humble verb 承る (うけたまわる: to receive, hear).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4 (かわせ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.explanation:
- **Meaning:** 為替 (かわせ) is a term with a special reading (ateji/jukujikun, 熟字訓) referring to foreign exchange, exchange transactions, or foreign-exchange rates (為替レート).
- Related kanji and readings:
  + 為 (to do, for): On-reading い in 行為 (こうい — action); kun-readings ため (for, because of), な・る (become), and す・る (do).
  + 替 (to replace, exchange): kun-readings か・える (change, replace) and か・わる (change); a common word is 両替 (りょうがえ — money exchange).
  + Common compounds: 外国為替 (がいこくかわせ — foreign exchange), 為替相場 (かわせそうば — foreign-exchange market/rate).
- Sentence translation: "Because of the nature of my work, I monitor and check foreign-exchange rates every day."

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.why.0: (a) 「りょうがえ」 is the reading of 「両替」 (currency exchange), not 为替.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.why.1: (b) 「ふりかえ」 is the reading of 「振替」 (transfer, substitution), not 為替.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.why.2: (c) 「かだん」 is the reading of 「花壇」, or it incorrectly combines the on-readings of 為 (い) and 替 (たい).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-5.why.3: (d) 「かわせ」 is the correct special reading (熟字訓) of the vocabulary item 「為替」 (foreign exchange, exchange rate).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-6.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1 (にぎやか).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-6.why.2: (c) 「ほがらか」is the kun-reading of 朗, as in 朗らか (cheerful, open, bright).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-7.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2 (かんし).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-7.why.1: (b) 「かんし」 is the correct on-reading of 「監視」: 監 (かん) + 視 (し).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-8.explanation:
- Meaning: 月賦 (げっぷ) means paying in monthly installments, equivalent to 月々の分割払い.

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-8.why.2: (c) 「げっぷ」 is the correct on-reading of 「月賦」: 月 changes from げつ to げっ, and 賦 changes from ふ to ぷ.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-8.why.3: (d) 「げっし」 is an incorrect reading, easily confused with 「月謝」 (げっしゃ - monthly tuition).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-9.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2 (じゃま).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-9.why.0: (a) 「でま」 is a loanword derived from German, meaning a false rumor or fabricated story; it is not the reading of 邪魔.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-9.why.1: (b) 「じゃま」is the correct on-reading of 「邪魔」: 邪 (じゃ) + 魔 (ま).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-9.why.2: (c) 「あくま」 is the reading of 「悪魔」 (demon, devil), which differs from 邪.

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2 (えんりょ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.explanation:
- Meaning: 遠慮 (えんりょ) means reserve, modesty, hesitation, or consideration for others. The phrase 「遠慮のない物言い」 means “blunt, outspoken speech without any restraint or consideration.”
- Related kanji and readings:
  + 遠 (far): on-reading えん in 遠足 (えんそく: excursion) and 永遠 (えいえん: eternity); kun-reading とお・い (far).
  + 慮 (consideration, thought): on-reading りょ in 考慮 (こうりょ: consideration) and 配慮 (はいりょ: consideration; thoughtfulness).

default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.why.0: (a) 「えんいん」 is the on-reading of 「遠因」 (a remote or indirect cause), not 遠慮.
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.why.1: (b) 「えんりょ」is the correct on-reading of 「遠慮」: 遠 (VIỄN—えん) + 慮 (LỰ—りょ).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.why.2: (c) 「えんかく」 is the reading of 「遠隔」 (remote, as in 遠隔操作) or 「沿革」 (history, development).
default.q.n1-u7-mon1-10.why.3: (d) 「えんせき」 is the reading of 「遠戚」 (a distant relative) or 「宴席」 (a banquet table or drinking party).
default.q.n1-u7-mon2-1.verdict: The correct answer is 3. 怠ける (read as なまける, meaning to be lazy or negligent).
default.q.n1-u7-mon2-1.explanation:
- Meaning of the sentence: “If I neglect my studies, I will certainly regret it in the future.”
- The kanji 怠 (lazy, negligent):
  + Kun-yomi: なま・ける (怠ける: to be lazy, or shirk one’s study/work responsibilities), おこた・る (怠る: to neglect, be careless about, or fail to attend to a duty or one’s health).
  + On-yomi: タイ (for example, 怠慢 - たいまん: negligence, irresponsibly careless behavior; 怠惰 - たいだ: laziness, indolence).

default.q.n1-u7-mon2-1.why.0: (a) Incorrect: 忠 (the 忠 in “loyal, honest”) has been confused with 怠 because both contain the 心 radical at the bottom; there is no word 「忠ける」.
default.q.n1-u7-mon2-1.why.1: (b) Incorrect: 忠 is not used in this verb and is not read as なまける.

default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.verdict: The correct answer is 1. 天井 (てんじょう — ceiling).
default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.explanation:
- Meaning: 天井 (てんじょう): ceiling; figuratively in economics and finance, a ceiling price, upper limit, or highest point.
- Distinguishing 天井 and 天上:
  + 天井 (てんじょう): the ceiling of a room, or the highest price limit (e.g., 天井知らず — rising without limit, soaring sky-high).
  + 天上 (てんじょう / てんじょうかい): heaven, the celestial realm, paradise (in contrast to the human world or hell).
- Kanji analysis:
  + 天: on-yomi テン, kun-yomi あめ / あま (heaven, sky). Related words: 天気 (てんき — weather), 天災 (てんさい — natural disaster).
  + 井: on-yomi セイ / ジョウ, kun-yomi い (well; a square grid shape). Related words: 井戸 (いど — well), 市井 (しせい — the streets, the common people).
- Example: 古い洋館の高い天井には、豪華なシャンデリアが飾られていた。(A magnificent chandelier hung from the high ceiling of the old Western-style mansion.)
default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.why.0: (a) Correct. 天 (heaven; sky) + 井 (well; square enclosure) = 天井 (ceiling; price ceiling).
default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.why.1: (b) Incorrect kanji: 「丼」 (as in 牛丼, 天丼, and 丼物—a Japanese rice bowl dish).
default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.why.2: (c) Incorrect for the context. 「天上」means the heavens or paradise, in contrast to the earthly world; it does not mean the ceiling of a room or warehouse.
default.q.n1-u9-mon2-10.why.3: (d) The wrong kanji 「場」is used; it does not form the vocabulary word for ceiling.

default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: 捕虜 (ほりょ).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.explanation:
- Sentence meaning: ほりょを監視する = monitor prisoners of war.
- Key vocabulary: 捕虜 (BỘ LỖ - ほりょ) means a prisoner of war.
- Detailed analysis of related kanji:
  + 捕 (BỘ - seize, capture): contains the hand radical (扌). On-reading ホ; kun-readings つか・まえる / と・らえる. Examples: 逮捕 (たいほ - arrest), 捕獲 (ほかく - capture).
  + 虜 (LỖ - prisoner of war, slave): on-reading リョ; kun-reading とりこ. Examples: 捕虜 (ほりょ - prisoner of war), 虜 (とりこ - someone captivated / an emotional captive, as in「心の虜になる」). Do not confuse it with 慮 (LỰ, as in 遠慮 and 考慮), which has the 心 radical underneath.
  + 補 (BỔ - supplement, make up for): contains the clothing radical (衤). On-reading ホ; kun-reading おぎな・う. Examples: 補給 (ほきゅう - supply), 補助 (ほじょ - assistance).
  + 浦 (PHỔ - bay, shore): contains the water radical (氵). Kun-reading うら. Example: 浦島 (うらしま).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.why.0: (a) 捕虜: Correct. 捕 (to catch; containing the 扌 radical) combines with 虜 (prisoner of war) to form the noun 捕虜 (ほりょ, prisoner of war).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.why.1: (b) 補慮: Incorrect. Both kanji are wrong: 補 (BỔ: compensate, supplement) and 慮 (LỰ: worry about, consider, as in 考慮).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.why.2: (c) 捕慮: Incorrect. 虜 was mistakenly written as 慮 (to think over or deliberate, as in 遠慮 and 考慮).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-1.why.3: (d) 浦虜: Incorrect. 捕 has been mistakenly written as 浦 (a riverside or beach, with the water radical 氵).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-2.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3: 退屈 (たいくつ).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-2.explanation:
- Sentence meaning: やることがなくたいくつだ = There is nothing to do, so I am bored.
- Key vocabulary: 退屈 (たいくつ) means boredom, dullness, or having nothing to do.
- Detailed analysis of the related kanji:
  + 退 (to withdraw, retreat): on-reading タイ; kun-readings しりぞ・く / しりぞ・ける. Examples: 退屈 (たいくつ, bored), 引退 (いんたい, retirement), 辞退 (じたい, decline, withdraw).
  + 屈 (to bend, submit): on-reading クツ. Examples: 屈服 (くっぷく, submission), 不屈 (ふくつ, indomitable), 屈指 (くっし, among the best).
  + 掘 (to dig): contains the hand radical 扌. On-reading クツ; kun-reading ほ・る. Examples: 発掘 (はっくつ, excavation), 掘削 (くっさく, digging, excavation).
  + 靴 (shoes): contains the leather radical 革. Kun-reading くつ. Examples: 長靴 (ながぐつ, boots), 靴下 (くつした, socks).

default.q.n1-u9-mon4-2.why.1: (b) 退掘: Incorrect. 屈 was mistakenly written as 掘, which means “to dig” in 発掘 and has the same on-reading クツ.
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-2.why.2: (c) 退屈: Correct. 退 (meaning “retreat”) combines with 屈 (meaning “bend, submit”) to form the na-adjective 退屈 (たいくつ: boring, tedious).

default.q.n1-u9-mon4-3.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 廃棄 (はいき).
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-3.explanation:
- Sentence meaning: ゴミをはいきする = to dispose of / destroy waste.
- Key vocabulary: 廃棄 (PHẾ KHÍ - はいき) means to discard, dispose of, or destroy (old items, garbage, hazardous waste, or an abolished treaty).
- Detailed kanji analysis and distinctions between homophones/near-synonyms:

  + 棄 (KHÍ - to throw away, abandon): On-reading キ. Examples: 放棄 (ほうき - abandonment of a right/responsibility), 破棄 (はき - destruction, cancellation of a contract), 棄権 (きけん - giving up one's right, abstaining from voting).
  + 排 (BÀI - to push out, exclude): On-reading ハイ. Examples: 排気 (はいき - exhaust gas, vehicle emissions), 排除 (はいじょ - exclusion, removal), 排出 (はいしゅつ - discharge, emissions).

default.q.n1-u9-mon4-3.why.1: (b) 発棄: Incorrect. 廃 was mistakenly written as 発.
default.q.n1-u9-mon4-3.why.2: (c) 排棄: Incorrect. 廃 (to discard) has been mistakenly written as 排 (to exclude or expel, as in 排除 and 排出).

default.q.n1-u9-mon4-5.explanation:
- Meaning of the expression: ますいを打つ = to administer an anesthetic / to give a local anesthetic injection.
- Key vocabulary: 麻酔 (ますい) means an anesthetic, a local anesthetic, or a medically induced state of anesthesia or numbness.
  (Note: In Japanese, 麻薬 - まやく refers to illegal addictive narcotics, whereas 麻酔 - ますい is the medical term for anesthesia or a local anesthetic.)
- Detailed analysis of the related kanji:

default.q.n2-u2-mon2-10.why.1: (b) 「拒まれた」: 拒, with the kun-reading こば・む, means “to refuse” or “to reject.” The passive form is こばまれた, meaning “was rejected.” This is the correct answer.

default.q.n2-u2-mon4-6.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: 追跡 (ついせき).

The word 追跡 (TRUY TÍCH - ついせき) means to follow someone’s trail in order to track their movements or pursue and apprehend them.

- Sino-Japanese meanings of related characters: 追 (TRUY - to pursue), 跡 (TÍCH - trace), 踊 (DŨNG - to dance), 踏 (TA - to tread), 距 (CỰ - distance). All four characters contain the 足 radical on the left, so their right-hand phonetic and semantic components must be carefully distinguished.
- Example: 警察は防犯カメラの映像を手がかりに、逃走した犯人を追跡した。(Using security-camera footage as a clue, the police tracked down the escaped criminal.)

default.q.n2-u2-mon4-6.why.3: (d) 追距 is incorrect because 距, as in 距離 (きょり, distance), is used for distance, not pursuit.
default.q.n2-u2-mon4-7.verdict: The correct answer is choice 3: 及ぼす (およぼす).

及ぼす (CẬP - およぼす) is a transitive verb commonly used in the fixed expression 「〜に影響を及ぼす」(to have an effect on..., to exert an influence on...).

- The on-reading of 及 is KYŪ (e.g., 普及 - ふきゅう: popularization, 追及 - ついきゅう: pursuing responsibility).

default.q.n2-u2-mon4-7.why.0: (a) 巨ぼす is incorrect because 巨, meaning “large” or “huge” as in 巨大, does not combine with the ending ぼす to form a verb.
default.q.n2-u2-mon4-7.why.1: (b) 拒ぼす is incorrect because 拒 (as in 拒否, refusal) has the kun-reading 拒む (こばむ).
default.q.n2-u2-mon4-7.why.2: (c) 及ぼす is correct. 及 has the kun-reading およ・ぼす and means to bring about or cause an effect or influence.
default.q.n2-u2-mon4-7.why.3: (d) 扱ぼす is incorrect because 扱, used in treating or handling something, has the kun-reading 扱う (あつかう).
default.q.n2-u2-mon4-8.verdict: The correct answer is choice 4: 踊る (おどる).

The kanji 踊 means dancing or moving to the rhythm of music.

default.q.n2-u2-mon4-9.verdict: The correct answer is choice 1: 染める (そめる).

The kanji 染 means to dye, soak through, or become infected with a habit or disease.

default.q.n2-u4-mon4-8.verdict: The correct answer is 4. 埋める (うめる – fill in a hole, bury).
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-8.explanation:
- Meaning: 埋める (MAI), pronounced うめる (umeru), means to fill in or bury a hole (or figuratively, to fill a gap or make up a financial shortfall).
- Kanji analysis:
  + 埋 (MAI): on-reading マイ (mai); kun-readings うめる (umeru—fill in/bury), うまる (umaru—be buried), and うもれる (umoreru—be buried/covered). Examples: 埋蔵 (まいぞう—burying and storing; deposits), 埋没 (まいぼつ—be submerged; be buried).
  + Note the following easily confused verbs ending in 「～める」:
    * 占める (しめる): occupy, account for (a percentage or position).
    * 含める (ふくめる): include, incorporate.
    * 認める (みとめる): recognize, acknowledge.
    * 埋める (うめる): fill in, bury.
- Example: 工事の現場にできた深い穴を土で埋めた。(The deep hole at the construction site was filled with soil.)
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-8.why.0: (a) 占める: Incorrect. 占 is read as しめる (shimeru), meaning “to occupy,” as in a proportion or position.

default.q.n2-u4-mon4-8.why.2: (b) ひってき: Correct. 匹 (ひつ, with sound contraction to ひっ) + 敵 (てき) is read 「ひってき」.
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-8.why.3: (d) 埋める: Correct. 埋 has the kun-reading うめる (umeru), meaning to fill in or bury (穴を埋める).
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-9.verdict: The correct answer is 3. 許す (ゆるす - to forgive, to allow).

- **Meaning**: 許す (HỨA) is read as ゆるす (yurusu) and means to forgive or permit; the idiom 心を許す (こころをゆるす) means to open up to and trust someone, without remaining guarded.
- **Kanji analysis**:
  + 許 (HỨA): On-reading キョ (kyo), kun-reading ゆるす (yurusu). Examples: 許可 (きょか - HỨA KHẢ: permission, authorization), 免許 (めんきょ - MIỄN HỨA: license, driver's license), 容認・許容 (きょよう - HỨA DUNG: acceptance, tolerance).
  + Common expressions:
    * 心を許す: to open up to and trust someone.
    * 罪を許す: to forgive someone's wrongdoing.
    * 許可を得る: to obtain permission.
- **Example**: 彼は親友にだけは心を許して何でも話す。(He opens up and talks about everything only with his best friend.)
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-9.why.0: (a) 離す: Incorrect. 離 is read as はなす here, meaning to separate or let go.

default.q.n2-u4-mon4-9.why.2: (c) 許す: Correct. The kanji 許 has the kun-reading ゆるす, and 心を許す means to open up to someone or trust them.

default.q.n2-u4-mon4-10.verdict: The correct answer is 1. 意識 (いしき - consciousness, awareness).

- **Kanji analysis**:
  + 意 (MEANING): On-reading イ (i). Examples: 意見 (いけん - OPINION), 意味 (いみ - MEANING), 意外 (いがい - UNEXPECTED).
  + 識 (KNOWLEDGE): On-reading シキ (shiki). Examples: 意識 (いしき - CONSCIOUSNESS), 知識 (ちしき - KNOWLEDGE), 認識 (にんしき - RECOGNITION OF AN ISSUE), 常識 (じょうしき - COMMON KNOWLEDGE).

default.q.n2-u4-mon4-10.why.0: (a) 意識: Correct. The kanji 意 combines with 識 to form 意識 (いしき – consciousness, awareness). The phrase 意識を失う means to lose consciousness or faint.
default.q.n2-u4-mon4-10.why.1: (b) Incorrect. 「認識」 is read にんしき (ninshiki) and means awareness or understanding of an issue.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-1.verdict: The correct answer is 1 (えんき): 延期 is read as えんき and means to postpone or reschedule.
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-1.explanation:
• **延期（えんき）**: postponement; to postpone or move an event to a later date.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-1.why.0: (a) Correct. 延期 has the Sino-Japanese reading えんき, corresponding to its on'yomi 「えんき」.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-2.verdict: The correct answer is 4 (こうし): 講師 is read as こうし and means lecturer.

• **講師（こうし）**: lecturer, instructor, teacher (at a university, school, specialized course, etc.).

• **無視（むし）**: ignore, disregard, pretend not to see/hear, turn a deaf ear to.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-4.verdict: The correct answer is 1 (こうほ): 候補 is read こうほ and means candidate or applicant.
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-4.explanation:
• **候補（こうほ）**: Candidate; a person or thing nominated or placed on a shortlist for consideration.
• **Related kanji:**
  - **候**: Weather, season, or waiting. On-reading: コウ (気候・きこう: climate; 天候・てんこう: weather).
  - **補**: To make up for, add, or assist. On-reading: ホ (補助・ほじょ: assistance; 補充・ほじゅう: supplementation; 補足・ほそく: additional details); kun-reading: おぎな・う.

• **Sentence translation:** Mr. A is known as a presidential candidate.
• **Additional example:** 彼は次期社長の最有力候補と目されている。(He is regarded as the leading candidate for the next term’s president.)
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-4.why.0: (a) Correct. 候補 has the Sino-Japanese reading 「こうほ」; 補 is read ほ with a short vowel, not a long vowel.
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-4.why.1: (b) Incorrect. 補 has only the on-reading 「ほ」, not the long-vowel reading 「ほう」. It is easily confused with 広報 (こうほう).

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-5.explanation:
• 生態系（せいたいけい）: ecosystem.
• Related kanji:
  - 生: to live, to be born. On-readings: セイ (生活・せいかつ, 生産・せいさん), ショウ (一生・いっしょう, 誕生・たんじょう); kun-readings: い・きる, う・まれる, なま...
  - 態: form, state, appearance. On-reading: タイ (状態・じょうたい: state; 態度・たいど: attitude; 事態・じたい: situation). This character is read たい, not voiced to だい.
  - 系: system, lineage. On-reading: ケイ (体系・たいけい: system; 系列・けいれつ: corporate group, chain).

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-5.why.0: (a) Incorrect. In 生態系, 生 uses the on-reading「せい」, not「しょう」, as in 一生・いっしょう.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-6.verdict: The correct answer is 3 (ゆかた): 浴衣 is read as ゆかた and means a yukata (a summer kimono).
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-6.explanation:
• **浴衣（ゆかた）**: yukata (a traditional lightweight cotton kimono, commonly worn in summer for fireworks displays, festivals, or after bathing in an onsen).
• **Special reading (熟字訓 - jukujikun):**
  - 浴衣 originally comes from the old term 「湯帷子（ゆかたびら）」, a garment worn while bathing in earlier times. The reading was later shortened to 「ゆかた」, and the kanji 「浴衣」 were adopted to represent it.
  - This is a reading assigned to the word as a whole (熟字訓), rather than a reading formed by separating the individual on-readings or kun-readings of the kanji.
• **Related kanji:**
  - **浴**: bathing, washing. On-reading: ヨク (海水浴・かいすいよく: sea bathing; 浴室・よくしつ: bathroom); kun-reading: あ・びる (to bathe, to pour water over oneself).
  - **衣**: clothing. On-readings: イ, エ (衣服・いふく: clothing; 衣食住・いしょくじゅう: food, clothing, and housing); kun-reading: ころも.
• **Sentence translation:** I wore a yukata to watch the fireworks festival.
• **Additional example:** 旅館に着いて、浴衣に着替えて温泉に入った。(I arrived at the ryokan, changed into a yukata, and went into the hot spring.)
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-6.why.0: (a) Incorrect. 「よくい」 combines the on-readings of the individual kanji (YOKU + I), but this word is read as jukujikun rather than by combining on-readings.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-6.why.2: (c) Correct. 浴衣 has the Sino-Japanese reading YUKI, but its special reading (熟字訓, jukujikun) is 「ゆかた」.
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-6.why.3: (d) Incorrect. It is misread with the voiced sound as 「ゆがた」, easily confused with 夕方・ゆうがた (evening).
default.q.n2-u5-mon1-7.verdict: The correct answer is 4 (けいさい): 掲載 is read けいさい and means to publish or post information or an article.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-8.verdict: The correct answer is 4 (きゅうえん): 救援 is read as きゅうえん and means relief or rescue assistance.

default.q.n2-u5-mon1-10.why.0: (a) Incorrect. 封 has the on-reading 「ほう」 (as in 封建・ほうけん), but in 封印 it is read 「ふう」.

default.q.n2-u5-mon2-1.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2 (福祉).

- **Meaning of the word**: 福祉（ふくし）means welfare, social welfare.

default.q.n2-u5-mon2-2.explanation:

  + 嫌われる（きらわれる）: to be disliked or hated (base verb: 嫌う - to dislike)
  + 祝われる（いわわれる）: to be congratulated (base verb: 祝う - to celebrate or congratulate)

default.q.n2-u5-mon2-3.explanation:
- **Word meaning**: 裏切る（うらぎる）means “to betray” or “to let someone down,” originating from the idea of “stabbing someone in the back” - 裏: the back/inside, 切る: to cut/slash. The passive form is 裏切られる（うらぎられる: to be betrayed）.

  + **裏**: the back, inside: kun-reading `うら` (裏 - the reverse/back side, 裏切る - to betray); on-reading `リ` (裏面 - りめん: reverse side).
  + **袋**: bag, sack: kun-reading `ふくろ` (袋, 手袋 - てぶくろ: gloves, ゴミ袋 - ごみぶくろ: garbage bag).
  + **装**: clothing, to pretend: on-readings `ソウ/ショウ` (服装 - ふくそう: clothing, 装置 - そうち: equipment); kun-reading `よそお・う` (装う: to pretend, disguise oneself).
  + **裁**: judgment, cutting/sewing: on-reading `サイ` (裁判 - さいばん: trial); kun-readings `さば・く` (裁く: to judge), `た・つ` (裁つ: cut fabric).

default.q.n2-u5-mon2-3.why.0: (a) Incorrect: 袋, read as ふくろ and meaning “bag” or “sack,” cannot be combined with 切る to form a verb meaning “to betray.”
default.q.n2-u5-mon2-3.why.1: (b) Incorrect: 装 (そう/よそおう: clothing, pretend) is not used in this word.
default.q.n2-u5-mon2-3.why.2: (c) Incorrect. 裁 (SAI: さい/さばく, judge, cut and sew) is not used in this word.
default.q.n2-u5-mon2-3.why.3: (d) Correct: 裏 (うら, the reverse side) + 切る (きる) forms the compound verb 裏切る (うらぎる, to betray); its passive form is 裏切られて.

  + 謝り（あやまり）: apology (from 謝る - あやまる)
  + 散り（ちり）: falling, scattering (from 散る - ちる)
  + 昇り（のぼり）: rising, ascent (from 昇る - のぼる)

• 荒 (KŌ - コウ / あら・い): grass radical 艹 + 亡 + 川 -> desolate, rough.
• 著 (CHO - チョ / いちじる・しい): grass radical 艹 + 者 -> work, prominent.

• 発展 (development): Used for growth in scale, expansion, or advancement of the economy, a country, a company, or a relationship (経済の発展, 事業の発展).

  + 慣: composed of the heart radical (忄) and 貫, suggesting that repeated experience leads to familiarity; its on-reading is「カン」(as in 習慣 しゅうかん - habit, custom).

  + 慣れない (なれない): not used to (from 慣れる なれる).
  + 折れない (おれない): not break (from 折れる おれる).

default.q.n3-u2-mon2-8.why.2: (c) Correct because 慣れない is read as なれない, the negative form of 慣れる (to become accustomed to, adapt).

default.q.n3-u2-mon2-9.verdict: The correct answer is 3. 残念 (ざんねん: regrettable, unfortunate).

  + 想: 相 + 心 -> 感想 (かんそう: impression, thoughts).

default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.verdict: The correct answer is 2. 窓口 (まどぐち: service counter, registration desk).
default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.explanation:
- Meaning: “Regarding applying for a credit card, I asked at the bank counter.”

  + 窓口 (SONG KHẨU - まどぐち): service counter, information desk, point of contact (at a bank, station, post office, hospital, etc.).
  + 窓 (SONG): The on-reading is 「ソウ」 (as in 同窓会 どうそうかい - alumni reunion/class reunion); the kun-reading is 「まど」 (window).
  + 口 (KHẨU): Its kun-reading changes to 「ぐち」 when it follows another noun (e.g., 改札口 かいさつぐち - ticket gate, 出口 でぐち - exit).
- Distinguishing kanji containing the 心 or 穴 radical:
  + 窓 (SONG): 穴 on top + 厶 and 心 below → 窓口 (まどぐち - service counter).
  + 忘 (VONG): 亡 + 心 → 忘れる (わすれる - to forget).
  + 感 (CẢM): 咸 + 心 → 感謝 (かんしゃ - gratitude, thanks).
  + 恋 (LUYẾN): A variant of 亦 + 心 → 恋愛 (れんあい - love, romance).

default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.why.0: (a) Incorrect because 忘 (わすれる, to forget) cannot be combined with 口 to form a meaningful word.
default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.why.1: (b) Correct because 窓口 is read as まどぐち and means a service counter or customer reception desk.
default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.why.2: (c) Incorrect because 感 (as in 感情 and 感謝) does not combine with 口 to form this word.
default.q.n3-u2-mon2-10.why.3: (d) Incorrect because 恋 (as in 恋人) cannot be combined with 口 to form this word.

default.q.n3-u2-mon3-2.explanation: 政治 (せいじ), read with the on-yomi, means politics or political affairs. 政 has the on-readings セイ and ショウ (for example, 政府 – せいふ: government; 摂政 – せっしょう: regency). 治 has the on-readings ジ and チ (for example, 治水 – ちすい: flood control; 治安 – ちあん: public security), and the kun-readings おさ・める and なお・る. default.q.n3-u2-mon3-2.why.0: (a) せいし: Incorrect. 治 in this word is read with dakuten as じ. せいし is the reading of 生死 (せいし, “life and death”) or 静止 (せいし, “stoppage”).
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-2.why.1: (b) せいじ: Correct. 政治 consists of 政 (CHÍNH - on-reading せい) and 治 (TRỊ - on-reading じ), and is read せいじ (politics).
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-2.why.2: (c) しょうし: Incorrect. 政 is not read as しょう here, and 治 is missing its voiced sound. しょうし is the reading of 少子, as in 少子化.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-2.why.3: (d) しょうじ: Incorrect. Although 治 is read じ, 政 in this word is read せい. しょうじ is the reading of 障子 (a Japanese sliding door).
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.verdict: The correct answer is 3. やね (屋根).
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.explanation: 屋根 (やね) means roof. It is a native Japanese compound formed from the kun-readings of two kanji: 屋 (kun-reading や: house or shop, as in 本屋 and 花屋) and 根 (kun-reading ね: root or base). The on-reading of 屋 is オク (for example, 屋上 - おくじょう: rooftop; 部屋 - へや: room). The on-reading of 根 is コン (for example, 根本 - こんぽん: root, foundation). Example: 屋根の上に猫がいます (There is a cat on the roof.)
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.why.0: (a) おくね: Incorrect. Combining the On-reading of 屋 (おく) with the Kun-reading of 根 (ね) is not the correct reading.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.why.1: (b) おくこん: Incorrect. Combining both on-readings, 屋 (おく) and 根 (こん), gives an incorrect reading for this word.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.why.2: (c) やね: Correct. 屋根 (roof) is read with the kun-readings of both kanji: 屋 (や) + 根 (ね) = やね.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-3.why.3: (d) やこん: Incorrect. Combining the kun-reading of 屋 (や) with the on-reading of 根 (こん) is an incorrect reading.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-4.verdict: The correct answer is 4. きかい (機械).

default.q.n3-u2-mon3-4.why.3: (d) きかい: Correct. 機械 is read with the standard on-readings as きかい, meaning machinery or machine.
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-5.verdict: The correct answer is 1. さまざま (様々).
default.q.n3-u2-mon3-5.explanation: 様々, read in kun-yomi as さまざま, is a na-adjective meaning diverse, varied, rich, multifaceted. 様 has the kun-yomi さま (an honorific: ～様: Mr./Ms., honored guest, etc.) and the on-yomi ヨウ (for example: 様子 - ようす: appearance, situation; 多様 - たよう: diverse). default.q.n3-u2-mon3-8.verdict: The correct answer is 3. あいじょう (愛情).

default.q.n3-u2-mon4-3.verdict: The correct answer is choice 2 (植える - うえる).
default.q.n3-u2-mon4-3.explanation:
「植える」has the kun-reading う・える and means to plant trees or sow crops. Its on-reading is ショク (e.g., 植物 - しょくぶつ: plant; 植木 - うえき: potted plant, ornamental tree). Expression: 木を植える (きをうえる) means "plant a tree."

Another example: 庭に花の種を植えました。(I planted flower seeds in the garden.)
